intro.text: A bridgeman in Sadeas's warcamp on the Shattered Plains and the bridgeleader of Bridge Three. He has a dark beard.

items.text: After Bridge Three lost two-thirds of its men on a run, Bussik tried to convince Gaz that his crew was too weak for stone-gathering. Kaladin volunteered Bridge Four instead, as a cover for gathering knobweed sap, and Gaz put Bussik's crew to cleaning pots.
Once Bridge Four began making bridge runs with hardly any losses, Bussik was among the bridgemen who grew angry with Kaladin. Kaladin realised the other crews no longer had anyone to look down on.
